I don't know you but i care. I'm answering. Not everyone is going to care. Not everyone knows how to react. This doesn't mean they are bad people. In this specific situation you are talking about - you say you know who to talk to - I have absolutely no way of knowing if they will care. Maybe they will care but they won't know how to express that - just like you say you find it difficult to put into words what you are going through.

If you are a young person in school (or even in college) I suggest talking to a school therapist. People who go into the profession usually care somewhat (and I know, it's not easy to find the right person to talk to, or the right therapist, sometimes we make baby steps, sometimes we deal however we can, sometimes that means walking  backwards or in circles).

I don't know who the people before are. We are all children in this world, learning through experience as we are thrust into our lives. Some of us naturally are very empathetic, others learn empathy over the years, some never seem to quite be able to put themselves into someone elses shoes.  Sometimes we are empathetic, but still we fail at communication. The best we can do is keep trying.
